page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a large woodcut initial V at the left beside the opening paragraph; a library stamp at the upper right (not transcribed); signature "a 2" at the foot.

main_text.head: CAELIUS SECUNDUS CURIO ILLUSTRI AC magnifico D.D. STANISLAO TENCINIO Comiti, Palatino Cracouiensi et Lublinensi, Belsensi, Vededouiensique Praefecto eiusque generoso filio Ioanni, S.P.D.
main_text.p: IDI statim, quum haec nostras Oratorias Explicationes ederem, TENCINI Comes Illustris, quid morosi quidam dicturi forent: quamquam parum tuta apud eos nostra existimatio futura esset. Nam quia aliquot alii uiri de literis praeclare meriti, suas in hunc Dialogum cogitationes euulgarunt, nos dicent non satis considerate fecisse, qui post tales uiros, aliquid in Oratorias partitiones edere uoluerimus: hoc est, Iliada post non dicā Homerū, sed Homeros conscripserimus. Quos etsi contenere, candidorum iudicio contentus, poteram: noluí tamen committere, ut eos sine responsione dimitterem. Quod cum fecce

page.notes: The opening word of the paragraph is set as a large woodcut initial; its letter is given as "V" with the rest "IDI" as printed. Library stamp "Biblioteca Romana Emanuele" at upper right and ink marks are not transcribed. Catchword reading "fecce" is uncertain. Text reads "quum" in the first line as printed.
